reviews.title: Keep Rescheduling
reviews.text: I have scheduled my flight early but this flight company keep on retimed and rescheduled the flight about 4-5 times last minutes. My schedule all spoil and pay for additional hotel fee due to the rescheduling
reviews.author: Dylan Tam

reviews.title: Avoid flying with Firefly / Fireflyz
reviews.text: was flying on 06.05.2023 from Singapore to Malaysia ( SZB ) and from Malaysia SZB to Kota Bharu ( KBR ). The first flight from Singapore to SZB was already changed by Firefly with 30 minutes. Arrived in SZB, Firefly was changing my flight 3 !!! times during waiting for the boarding. First change with 1 hour, second by 30 minutes and third by 20 minutes. Due to the fact, a driver and a ferry to my final destination was waiting for me, it seems like I am not able to make it on time ( thanks Firefly ) and I was heading to the airport office for help. When asking for a solution, first was - no compensation possible due to technical issues bla bla..... I have to really make clear, I will be not make it to my final destination and getting a no-show fee and have to pay for the driver twice. What solution they can offer me. I looked into three perplexed faces that couldn't give me an answer. I offered Firefly to take care of it themselves, Firefly would have to pay a separate boat transport of the equivalent of 500 MYR to get me to my destination the same day. However, they could not give me a commitment to cover these costs, instead offered me an overnight stay in a hotel in Kota Bharu and a ride in a cab to it. I tried to explain that my costs are higher than the stay in a rundown hotel and a cab ride there, They would like to find a reasonable solution for both sides and that would be a transport on the same day to my vacation destination. Long story short, I would have to pay for the additional boot transfer myself and could then submit this we hotline and e-mail. One will then consider this separately due to the delays and circumstances. This I did, however I got a ridiculous answer and they offered me a refund of 200 MYR from the 580 MYR I had already paid, which is not even half of my costs. Thus, I am now stuck with additional costs that could have been easily taken over by Firefly to find a reasonable compensation. Just save yourself all this inconvenience and book with a reasonable airline that also have an interest in their customers !!!! Im done with FIREFLYZ and all lies and excuses ive heard and read.
reviews.author: Bastie L

reviews.title: Lousy Airline
reviews.text: My flight was rescheduled to 2 hours plus because this airline simply changed my flight time. I paid for 8pm flight and my flight time was changed to 10.10pm without any valid reason. Yet, i saw another bunch of people was able to take the flight which is on my original booked flight time! My seat was simply given to someone else and wasted my 2 hours sitting here to wait for another flight! Me and my company will ban this firefly airline and never choose to fly with this company anymore!
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Avoid - utter dog sh*t
reviews.text: 2 days out from our holiday we got a notification that our flight times had changed by a day and a half. Not an hour or two but as far into the following day as possible. With hotels and flights already locked in for a month and a company that doesn’t answer their support line, this airline is utter dog sh*t. Our only option was to book with another airline at twice the price (being so close to departure day).
reviews.author: dayyan_james

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY TICKETS FROM FIREFLY! IT'S A SCAM COMPANY!
reviews.text: My flight from KNO-PEN was rescheduled by the airlines. Supposedly, since it's not my fault, I should be given option to refund or reschedule, but no! We don't get anything! We can only follow whatever schedule firefly has set. So the option is to follow the new schedule or lose your ticket and money! Is this even allowed??
reviews.author: Damon Lee

reviews.title: A good choice for Kuala L. - Singapore route
reviews.text: Perhaps nothing extraordinary but it was a good choice. Flying from SZB is fantastic. no crowds, very fast security check and you are on board within minutes, ATR is fine for short flights. Some basic service (water and snacks) is more than enough. If you are lucky you may have amazing views on Singapore on approach to XSP.
reviews.author: Slawek Z

reviews.title: Dreadful Experience
reviews.text: The Flight from Hell. Set off on time but Flight got diverted to Johor Senai - supposedly because Seletar was closed due to bad weather (it wasn’t). Arrived over 4 hours late. Firefly had zero contingency plan for this eventuality and it was a terrible experience to get from Johor Senai to Singapore - as an example, they dumped off passengers in a remote Singapore lay-by. Firefly basically washed their hands of their paying customers. My advice: do not fly this abysmal airline, they cannot handle issues and they do not care about their customers. And rain is an issue for them. I will never fly Firefly again.
reviews.author: Jonathan C

reviews.title: Firefly constantly delayed for evening flights.
reviews.text: Been flying back and forth between Penang and Subang over the passed months. Not once was my flight not delayed. The reason given is always weather conditions, with delays ranging from 30 mins to an hour. I fly in the evening often rushing to the airport after work, it’s annoying to have to check in and then wait for hours every time.
reviews.author: Robyn Lim

reviews.title: Firefly Airline : SIN to KL
reviews.text: Perfectly reasonable short, 1hr 20 mins flight that arrived on time. Reasonably comfortable seats with sufficient legroom. We were given small mineral water, peanuts and Famous Amos cookies as refreshments. Check-in was a breeze. As there were only 40 passangers on the flight, we cleared custom in 10-15 mins. Super fast compared to KLIA custom. 20kg baggage were included which is a plus point. Firefly Airlines’ XSP/SZB route has a bunch of advantages: - close proximity of Subang Airport to KL. Grab to our hotel is only 20 mins @ RM18. - smooth immigration clearance at both airports (fuss-free border control and short walking distance at both SZB & XSP - you can already see the planes at immigration clearance area) - at XSP you can probably come 30 mins prior to departure and still catch your flight but for SZB you might need more time if you are doing bag drop otherwise 30 mins is possible too - planes depart shortly after boarding and take off as soon as they reach the runway (provided weather is clear for take off) - if you stay in the Northeast or North, Seletar Airport is near and less travel time home
reviews.author: sweetie_inc

reviews.title: Great deal and service for short hop in Malaysia
reviews.text: Generally what you would expect, great service, on time, comfortable and would use anytime for a similar short hop.
reviews.author: mark f

reviews.title: Frequent flight cancellation and does not inform about seat changes
reviews.text: This will be the last time we fly Fireflyz and I will be on a crusade to discourage anyone else from flying with this airline. Just on this trip alone, we have experienced the usual cancellation of flights we booked at 4pm, pushed to last flight of the day at 6:10pm. Then delayed till 6:30pm. Changed gates without announcement. Didn’t put us on our paid and selected premium seats. Didn’t inform us and didn’t offer any refund automatically. We had similar experience the last time in July flying from Penang to Subang. Also got caught paying for lounge service in Penang which doesn’t have a lounge. I paid for lounge in Subang and could only use in Subang. When I complained they pointed me to check the fine print in the booking page. What a lousy operations and customer service. Avoid at all cost.
reviews.author: Michael

reviews.title: What A Joke. Last minute delay and don't even apologize for it.
reviews.text: Was informed Just 1 day in prior of the departure and no compensation of whatsoever. Even cancellation of flight will only be refunded by credit, which has an expiry of 90 days. Even Better? Can only redeem for same flight.
reviews.author: Alvin

reviews.title: RODDERS
reviews.text: I normally use AirAsia,but not suitable times for me. So I know from reviews, that the service is always questionable.However I thought 40 min flight no problem. I WAS WRONG DELAYED 1 HOUR ALREADY.OMG!!
reviews.author: Rodders C

reviews.title: What a terrible way to fly
reviews.text: Our flight was delayed more then 3+ hrs from the original takeoff 9am then we can fly around 12.30pm. Was given 1 chicken burger 🍔 +water. My plans all ruined and my other tickets for me and wife to transfer all gone down the drain! I don’t have problem with MAS but this is too much to stomach. It ruined all our holiday mood
reviews.author: Sien Loong S

reviews.title: Short flight, no drama
reviews.text: Perfectly reasonable short, 2 hour, flight that arrived on time. Reasonably comfortable seats with sufficient legroom. Very reasonable fare so what’s not to like?
reviews.author: Hepatacyte

reviews.title: Horrible service
reviews.text: What a horrible and irresponsible service. Don’t understand the the 3 hrs delay when the weather is so good. I am seeing 2 Malindo planes departing now. Unacceptable service and my arrangements for pickup at Subang Airport disrupted. Will never fly Firefly again.
reviews.author: Sulaiman

reviews.title: Disappointed!
reviews.text: I had a domestic flight recently. My friend received a sms that the flight was delayed but I didn't. So I still rushed to the airport following the original timing. I checked the airport online flight status, it showed the flight was not delayed and its on time. When I reached it was actually delayed. And when I asked the person at the counter if it is delayed, why no email, or why some of us didn't get the sms, or why not the airport online flight status was updated regarding the delay, her answer was simply ' I don't know'. I've travelled in various airlines and I chose firefly because of their timing and very less chances of delay. I don't blame them for delaying but at least have the courtesy to update the online flight status or proper answer!!! Completely disappointed with firefly!
reviews.author: Riya

reviews.title: Scam operator - avoid
reviews.text: If you make a booking mistake they wouldn't let you cancel the flight for free within 24h after booking like most airlines do these days. They would rather offer you a change that's more expensive than the original ticket. If you don't put in the middle names which they BTW have no field for in their booking form they have to make you pay again.
reviews.author: tmiskiew

reviews.title: awesome help desk team
reviews.text: i really want to make an effort to write a review for them. i had never call a budget airline help desk and get such pleasant attention. during covid, it had been extremely difficult to utilisé my rm800 crédits due to the closure of border. they had been very helpful to extend the credits for 2-3 times the last 2 years. they had also assist me with purchasing the tickets for third party since i’m not able to use it in malaysia. the help desk are very well informed, patient and helpful. not to mention, other airline, you might even have a hard time to call through. this help desk team truly deserve some applause. i can’t wait for the seletar and szb airport to resume.
reviews.author: chaiyen

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: Wouldn't let us check in because we hadn't put in middle names, which I never put in flight bookings. Then charge us rm450 just to add middle names. Compete rip off and avoid.
reviews.author: Gerard R

reviews.title: Efficient and excellent ground staff service
reviews.text: I recently flew via Firefly for a business/leisure trip. I had to carry several items over for my clients in Kuala Lumpur. Unfortunately due to my own carelessness I left one package at the Boarding Gate A1 in Penang Airport. I only realized it while in the plane to Subang. Immediately once I arrived, I went straight to the customer office where Lonnie served me. I would like to praise her and her team mates (Azuar and Laila) in Penang for their efficiency on finding the package and sending it to me on the next flight which I retrieve it in good condition from Sri at the Subang Firefly. Lonnie was so reassuring to me throughout the whole process as we were in communication via whatsapp.
reviews.author: payselt

reviews.title: TERRIBLE AND WORST PURCHASE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text: I had a terrible and worst experience with Firefly Airline today which is I had purchased the air ticket from KUL-BKI for three person and then after I make the payment I go and check my booking history under Firefly account, I found that the reservation status is shown ''UNCONFIRMED''. And I saw there is a remark showing there to wait 30 minutes for the ticket confirmation and itinerary will be receive in email, but I've received nothing after 30 minutes. So that I called to office for checking and your team saying that my final status of my booking is UNCONFIRMED due to the code share flight unable to confirmed by MALAYSIA AIRLINES so that this booking is not valid, and will make the refund to me within 30 to 60 working days. I was truly mad when I heard this, if the flight is unavailable and unable to confirm then how come you still open your flights at website for us to book like a trap??? Then you locked our money for 2 months only can do the refund??? Is really ridiculous!!! I'm really disappointed on Firefly Airline with my first terrible purchase experience. Because I pay the money to your airlines and then you said the booking is unable to confirmed this really makes me felt like I'm get cheated.
reviews.author: ChoCobabe A

reviews.title: Disappointing approach to passenger safety
reviews.text: Bad: filling the plane to capacity with absolutely no distancing between passengers – yes I know the government allows you to do this – but it’s not great in such a small cabin Worse: Not sterilising or disinfecting the aircraft in any way between flights. This should be a mandatory thing you would have hoped. Deplorable: Not enforcing passengers to wear face masks at any point during boarding, inflight and disembarking. Within two rows to the front and side of me there were 3 passengers either not wearing masks at all for the duration or doing that dumb thing of wearing them under their chin. When I asked one of the cabin crew about this, I just got a nervous smile and shrug of the shoulders – that’s it.
reviews.author: Phil Calam

reviews.title: Convenient to fly from Subang Airport
reviews.text: Most people would usually take SIN/KUL (the usual route) but Firefly Airlines’ XSP/SZB route has a bunch of advantages: - close proximity of Subang Airport to KL (there’s even commuter railway now) - smooth immigration clearance at both airports (fuss-free border control and short walking distance at both SZB & XSP - you can already see the planes at immigration clearance area) - at XSP you can probably come 30 mins prior to departure and still catch your flight but for SZB you might need more time if you are doing bag drop otherwise 30 mins is possible too - planes depart shortly after boarding and take off as soon as they reach the runway (provided weather is clear for take off) - my last plane boarding was at 4.30pm and the plane started moving at 4.44pm (scheduled departure was 4.45pm) but due to poor weather the plane was stuck on the runway for a while - if you are a Singapore resident who stays in Northeast (Hougang-Sengkang-Punggol) or North (Yishun), Seletar Airport is not too far away (less travel time home) Nevertheless, there are also factors that might not make sense: - you don’t like turboprop planes (too noisy) - you actually stay near KLIA or south of it - you don’t stay near Seletar Airport (though I think the time savings from smoother travel procedures are being offset with the travel time to other parts of Singapore) - might be quite expensive at times; you might need to book early to have a reasonable fare (some prefer to go to KL in short notice) Photo: My last flight boarding at Subang Airport in March - was raining super heavily but the staff gave us umbrellas to allow us to walk to the plane.
reviews.author: darkhonour

reviews.title: Need to Improve
reviews.text: A number of observations about my experience Originally booked via Expedia. For some reason I was unable to log onto Firefly website to make amendments from UK, Singapore or Malaysia until 2 days before departure. Expedia couldn’t help. All phone numbers listed were called with no answer. While in Georgetown we went to call in to the Firefly agency office as we were passing. This office has closed. Called the airport office within the hours, no joy. Eventually this was sorted and the website was relatively easy to navigate although the booking of additional baggage was a little confusing. Compared with other airline websites, not the best. Checked in online. When at the airport we looked for bag drop - nothing. Asked around. Plenty of Malaysian and Air Asia staff but they knew nothing of Firefly procedure. Check in desks 23-25. Two flights checking in, only one desk open, one, poor suffering staff member trying to cope. Late passengers for the earlier flight jumping to the front of single queue. The fact I had checked in online did not seem to make any difference. A return to old school with issuing of boarding cards and allocated seats and this poor lady working like a Trojan checking bag weights and tagging. At the boarding gate there were too many people for the space. There seemed to be little organisation. The aircraft boards from the rear. It would be sensible to board the front seats first and work back but this didn’t happen, consequently passengers waiting to pass down the cabin. Arrived at our seats to find them occupied. Those persons had been moved because their seats had been occupied. What muppetry here. In the event of the unthinkable how do they work out who sat where? We were quickly allocated a seat further to the front so no issues but it did leave me wondering about the seat allocation etc. The aircraft itself 11yrs old (I googled it). Has it ever been cleaned? Dirty tired interior with windows you could barely see out of. I guess these are highly utilised aircrafts but I have similar experience of same aircraft type in Europe and they are looked after much better. In flight complimentary drink is a cup of apple juice which I guess was fine for a 35 minute island hop. Overall experience average. I would not hurriedly recommend this airline. Feeling of being run on the cheap in a highly competitive market. Expected more.
reviews.author: TinpusherCheshire

reviews.title: Great Flight TERRIBLE Customer Service
reviews.text: This started bad, the website took a double payment. I called Firefly and 3 agents hung up on me. I sent 3 enails and no reply. As i write this i was charged twice and have had no help. The flight was great. The customer service TERRIBLE
reviews.author: M16content

reviews.title: Highly efficient Penang to KL flight
reviews.text: Our flight was fantastic. Check in was quick and the flight was on time. We were traveling with two little kids and everyone - ground staff and flight crew - was very friendly and paid extra attention to our comfort. Flight time was only 45 minutes and bags came out quickly. Subang is a great airport for quickly reaching anywhere in KL.
reviews.author: ProverbialYeti

reviews.title: Takes an hour for bag drop!!
reviews.text: Horrible experience with firefly, travelling back to Subang from Penang airport for holiday and we have to wait an hour just to drop our bags. There is only one counter open when we joined the queue, even after another counter opened it did little to speed up the check in and bag drop which was combined to one queue.
reviews.author: Ho Mun Kiat

reviews.title: Flying from seletar airport to kl
reviews.text: Simple and convenient way of flying to kl. Seletar airport checkin need 30mins before hand. It so near to waiting area and with low passengers ,the waiting area is quiet and comfortable.
reviews.author: HL888

reviews.title: Comfortable and friendly crews
reviews.text: This was my first flight with Firefly. Quite impressive by the on time departure and arrival. The seats are wide and padded so its soft for your back, ample leg room, adjustable seats and clean floor carpet. Although it was an hour flight, they served drinks and light snacks. The price is inclusive of refreshments and baggage. Definitely will fly again.
reviews.author: MizSally24

reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text: Flew from Johor Bahru to Subang and return on Firefly on an ATR72-500 plane. The service is fantastic with very friendly air stewardesses. Even in a short distance flight of 1 hour you are served apple juice or soya drink plus either a piece cake or a packet of peanuts. The only drawback was the old noisy plane when we flew to Subang. The return flight had a newer and better plane. Overall will recommend Firefly with the most friendly air stewardesses that I have come across.
reviews.author: Joseph O

reviews.title: You need to allocate spare time for flight delay
reviews.text: a good and safe flight except the for delay on the first leg which was more than an hour and half. Pilot was apologetic and explained the delay. Overall a good flight for short distance.
reviews.author: HJY

reviews.title: A broken bag, but with a replacement bag sent back to me
reviews.text: Firefly, flight FY 4111 from Penang to Kuala. Nice and fast ride back home, with an ontime departure. Flights are operated with ATR 42 : prop planes. Unfortunately, when the bag were delivered on KL airport, one of the wheel had been totally pulled apart and was missing, leaving a big hole on my bag. I lodged a report with their ground staff which happened to be very nice and efficient. 2 choices given to me : a) 50 ringgint cash immediately for compensation ( 12 euros ) b) A new replacement bag would be provided back to me. Obviously, I chose b) I was told that I would receive the bag in 2 weeks time. After 3 weeks, my bag had not yet been delivered, and I decided to leave that mattter. Surprisingly, 2 days ago, after maybe 1,5 month, I had the happy surprise to receive a call from a delivery company, for my new bag. Bag is not of super high grade, but failry good. So, very happy with the job done by Firefly, and their customer service.
reviews.author: Thierry KL

reviews.title: Worse airport and worse flight to take
reviews.text: One of the hopeless flight. Always get cancel. Always reroute to other airport. Since government implemented manual landings system so called, always have problem. Guys I guys is not safe to take this flight. Waste time and waste money.
reviews.author: das

reviews.title: One quick flight but a good one
reviews.text: An early morning flight from Penang to Kota Bharu in order to get to the Perhentian Islands. It was a smallish 4 engine turbo prop plane but very smooth in operation. The plight was only one hour but in that time the staff served coffee and biscuits. The flight itself was scenic as we flew over the mountain range and then down into Kota Bharu. Good helpful staff and a smooth checkin. They , like Air Asia also have a self serve kiosk but for some reason our reservation number didn't work on it and we just checked in at the desk , no drama. Would we fly Firefly again ? Yes , no worries .
reviews.author: Peter K

reviews.title: The friendliest Airline I've ever used
reviews.text: I've used Firefly quite frequently, be it from Subang to Langkawi, Singapore Seletar (*Yes the new Airport for the Turboprops), Penang, and most recently to Johor Bahru, and they have worked perfectly everytime.
reviews.author: crazygweilo

reviews.title: Subang to Johor Bahru
reviews.text: A good flight that was on time. Good price, friendly crew and good complimentary in flight F&B. The cabin however looks a bit tired even though the seat covers had just been changed. Overall a good flight
reviews.author: Alan_Bligh

reviews.title: FireFly and Malaysia Airlines. Doomed to failure.
reviews.text: Book FireFly and Malaysia Airlines at your own risk. They simply don’t have the know-how or customer service to run an airline. Boarded the aircraft sat on hot tarmac for an hour. Then passengers are notified there is a problem and told to exit the aircraft. They are disorganized, providing little to no information for passengers, and not in a hurry at all to fix the problem. This airline has gone downhill fast. I can understand now how they can lose an entire aircraft in the ocean and never know what happened. They just can’t run an airline. FireFly and Malaysia Airlines NOT RECOMMENDED.
reviews.author: Snrklman

reviews.title: Good flight for short trip
reviews.text: If you plan for a flight to nearby cities which took you less than an hour, this flight may be your selection.
reviews.author: H.T NG

reviews.title: Lines Too Long
reviews.text: We waiting in line for over a half hour at the airport. The process was very slow. The agents tried to up sale us for coverages we didn't need. We will never use Firefly again; which we got from Rentalcars.com.
reviews.author: howardgayheart

reviews.title: Shuttle flight
reviews.text: It was the first time I took a domestic flight to Johor Bahru, a usual drive to Johor Bahru from Kuala Lumpur will take a minimum of 3-4 hours depending on the traffic however my journey was less than 1 hour and it was a great relief and made me very happy and I was very fresh as how I left home. Firefly was on time and perfect for short-distance travel.
reviews.author: Nirmala

reviews.title: You think you can book a great flight with Expedia?
reviews.text: In Sept. 2018 I booked through Expedia 2 Firefly tickets from Singapore to Ipoh departing Mar. 4, 2019. Upon arrival at Changi Airport on Mar 4, I found Singapore Authorities would not permit Firefly operate in Changi Airport since Dec. 1, 2018. The Firefly rep told us Firefly did notify all parties concerned but not direct to us because my booking was through Expedia. Yet Expedia still e-mailed us on Mar. 2 confirming the flight. The rep apologized, refunded MYR456 to my credit card, and helped to buy same day tickets from Scoot for S$244, approx. C$100 more than I originally paid. I phoned and emailed Expedia requesting them to compensate me the difference. But they kept referring me to contact Firefly directly as mentioned in their replies: “The airline actually requires all passengers to contact them directly after the booking with Expedia.” “... we did not receive any notification from Firefly...”. Expedia's role is to book flights, get the commission, then anything happen afterwards is none of their business! Being a leading travel agency, how can they be so irresponsible, unprofessional and ignorant of what is happening in the travel world! Now I learn travel agencies are not reliable so don't ever trust them. This lesson cost me C$100! Fellow travelers please keep close contact with the airlines at all times.
reviews.author: Pamela L

reviews.title: Fussfree and alternative route from Subang to Singapore
reviews.text: Seating is more spacious than Airasia. Pricing is comparable to other budget airlines especially this is the only airline that depart from Subang - save me the hassle of traveling from PJ to KLIA (~45mins) vs PJ to Subang (~<20mins). Complimentary refreshment, which is nice. It takes slightly longer than other budget airline due to the model of the plane, which is not a problem for me. Love the fuss-free and simple Seletar airport vs Changi airport, where more walking (& shopping) is required. The pockets behind the seats are filthy (where brochures and all are kept) so refrain from touching it if possible.
reviews.author: holidayyo

reviews.title: A great way to fly into seletar airport
reviews.text: Sultan Azlan Shah airport (or also previously known as Subang Airport) is another airport to fly in & out of Kuala lumpur. The distance from KL is nearer than going to klia. Thus cheaper. But there are a couple of tol gates to pass thru (the same as klia). The airport being smaller & older lacks the superior charm of klia but not lacking in service, restaurants & not as crowded. Checking in & out was a breeze. Taking firefly to seletar was a good experience. Being a small plane, it was comfortable enough. Having some refreshments given by the air stewardess was an added value cos some airlines at klia don't give even a drink for short distance journey. Had a choice of either juice or soya milk & a pkt of curry puff or muffin. Landing in to seletar airport was great cos I stay near the airport. With the newly renovated airport, it was smooth in & out of immigration.
reviews.author: Siti220

reviews.title: Graet short destination flight
reviews.text: Very convienient to fly out off Subang to local destinations in Malaysia. Service is great and the cabin crew are very hospitable. Usually always on time.
reviews.author: Philip G

reviews.title: On time, as ALWAYS, delightful staff, as ALWAYS, fast luggage collection, as ALWAYS, EXCELLENT!
reviews.text: Highly recommended, all ATR fleet, terrific staff free 20KG luggage, CLEAN aircraft. Delicious complementary snack on board, could not ask for more on a budget carrier - these guys "set a high standard", in their field. Well done, and Thank You! SO MUCH better than Jetstar, they suck!
reviews.author: Put - Mark J

reviews.title: Flying from KL Subang airport to Singapore Seletar airport is less stressful
reviews.text: I always like to fly from KL Subang airport to Singapore Changi airport as it is less crowded and less stressful than flying from KLIA1 of KLIA2. Once I was caught at the KLIA1 airport with about 600 people waiting to clear immigration. It was so stressful as some have to cut cue so as not to miss their flight. Subang airport is such a breeze as there is hardly a line at the immigration counter. When I entered the Firefly Turbo Prop aircraft, I noticed the refurbished seats, in black and red. Looks great and welcoming. When I sat down, I immediately felt the comfort. It is one on the better economy class seats. The place left on time and fly off immediately as there was no cue for aircraft taking off. We arrived at Seletar airport 15 minutes ahead of time as there was no cue landing the aircraft too. The captain took off and landed the plane perfectly. I was surprised to see a lady Captain. I spoke with her and I can feel she loves flying and she really enjoys what she is doing. This is the first time I landed at Seletar airport. At present, it handles few aircrafts. The airport is newly renovated. Looks cheerful and peaceful. Clearing immigration and customs was a breeze. We were out in 10 minutes. Flying from KL via Subang airport and arriving at Singapore Seletar airport is so much less stressful. I really like the small town feel of these two smaller airports. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Loh K W

reviews.title: Fun Turbo Prop
reviews.text: Haven't been on a turbo prop in years. A little more interesting, the change, than typical jet flight. Both airports are small so on and off was fast and easy.
reviews.author: A S

reviews.title: Firefly Airlines
reviews.text: The flight was only 30 minutes so was over before you got settled into your seat but orange juice or water was served. The price for my flights was really good and was the cheapest. The people travelling solo had an empty seat next to door and everyone was spaced out evenly. I have been on Qantas where there have been rows but have put me next to stranger instead of a seat on my own. Love Firefly.
reviews.author: Christine

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Booked this flight as it was with the most convenient timing for me. Arrived about 2 hours to departure but check-in counter not opened, they only open 1 hour 30 minutes before departure. Flight departed and arrived on time. Aircraft old but the seat covers had just been changed so cabin looked refreshed. Good service from crew. Happy with experience
reviews.author: Alan_Bligh
